english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for one's own house or one's parental home.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a person's home or dwelling.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for the place that is one's home.
Use this for someone's home or household when the dwelling is personal rather than a generic place of residence.
Use 屋企 when “place” means someone’s home or the place where they live.

examples.english: I'm not going home for dinner tonight.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 m4 faan1 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6

examples.english: There’s a pretty good cha chaan teng near my residence.
examples.traditional: 我屋企附近有間幾好食嘅茶記。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 fu6 gan6 jau5 gaan1 gei2 hou2 sik6 ge3 caa4 gei3

examples.english: After work, I most want to head straight back to my homestead.
examples.traditional: 放工之後，我最想即刻返屋企。
examples.jyutping: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 zeoi3 soeng2 zik1 hak1 faan1 uk1 kei2

examples.english: I'm going back to my habitation after dinner tonight.
I go back to my place after work.
examples.jyutping: fong3 gung1 ngo5 zau6 faan1 uk1 kei2
